```{r}
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
input <- readLines("data1")
```

Part1

```{r}
s <- readChar("data1", file.info("data1")$size)
r <- str_count(string = s, pattern = '\\(') - str_count(s, '\\)')
r
```

Part2

```{r}
pars <- strsplit(s, split = "")[[1]]
floor <- 0
step <- 1
while (floor>-1) {
  k <- pars[step]
  if (k == "(") {
    floor <- floor + 1
  }
  else {
    floor <- floor - 1
  }
  step <- step + 1
}
step-1
```

Part1v2

```{r}
input %>% 
  str_split("") %>%
  unlist() %>% 
  {ifelse(. == "(", 1, -1)} %>% 
  sum()
```

Part2v2

```{r}
input %>% 
  str_split("") %>%
  unlist() %>% 
  {ifelse(. == "(", 1, -1)} %>% 
  cumsum() %>% 
  {which(. < 0)} %>% 
  .[1]
```

Part1v3

```{r}
input %>%
  str_replace_all(pattern = "\\(", replacement = "+1") %>% 
  str_replace_all(pattern = "\\)", replacement = "-1") %>% 
  parse(text = .) %>% 
  eval()
```
